// Positive control (#5170): the early-returning `kind !== 'unreadable'` test leaves the statements after
// it as the unreadable arm, and they pass.
import { gateVerdict } from './gate-verdict.cjs';
import { readTextEvidence } from './gate-evidence.cjs';

export function evaluateFixtureGate(planPath: string) {
  const plan = readTextEvidence(planPath);
  if (plan.kind !== 'unreadable') {
    return gateVerdict('block', true, { checked: plan.kind });
  }
  return gateVerdict('pass', false, { reason: plan.reason });
}
